justification: Blake Corum earned every bit of that nineteen-point week responding the way we asked him to, but a man can't suit up on a bye, so we're not asking the impossible of him this week - Etienne and Dowdle have both shown up and done their job in their backfields all year, so they split the carries at RB2 and FLEX and I trust either one with the ball. Same story with Wan'Dale - he's still working his way back and that's not a knock on him, it's just not his week, so Amon-Ra slides over to a true receiver spot where he belongs after the kind of Sunday he just turned in. Cousins keeps the ball because he's been a pro everywhere he's gone, Keenan Allen keeps earning his targets, Andrews keeps doing his job underneath, and the Chargers defense gets the start over a unit that's barely active right now. Clear eyes, full hearts - we play the men who are ready to play.
